author: qu0b
content:
Follow up report on the second spam wave <https://panda-uploads-production.devops-539.workers.dev/panda/uploads/c761e4/glamsterdam-devnet-7-self-built-blocks-round-2.html> Now available with a lot of comparisons and updates on what we've been testing. Its a really nice overview, don't take everything for granted, but its a good guiding tool on how the devnet was doing during consistent load. A lot of the issues flaged in the first report have been resolved and fixed <a:partyGlasses:851583814145015839> . 

Notable changes:
- builder path withheld payloads (testing vector)
- deathstar reorging
- geth had some regressions
- some really nice charts for example the payload reveal timing self vs builder built. 
- a nice overview over which issues got resolved since the last report
